From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: PO timing / invoice cadence for Starlight (LOI signed)

Team — quick heads up. Starlight (external) signed their LOI yesterday for $420,000 ARR (pilot -> annualized). They returned a PO draft that has two items that will block timely revenue recognition for the March quarter unless we align: 

1) Billing start date on their PO is "upon SOW acceptance" but they expect Redwood invoices to follow a calendar-month schedule (invoices issued on 1st of month).
2) Payment terms on their PO are Net-45; our standard is Net-30 for new mid-market deals.

Attached: Starlight_PO_Draft.pdf, SOW_Starlight_v3.docx.

Asks:
- David: can revenue ops accept Net-45 for initial pilot and allow recognition to start in March if PO is signed before 3/5? We need to confirm for forecasting.
- Karthik: if PO arrives after the start of month, can billing issue a prorated invoice and still close the booking for March? Any system constraints?
- Rishi: any contract/legal flags on the PO wording re: start date that would require redline before countersign?

If we can get agreement today, I will loop in the Starlight procurement contact and propose a 3/3 sign-off timeline. If we can't, the booking will slip into April, which materially changes Q1 recognized revenue.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: PO timing / invoice cadence for Starlight (LOI signed)

Marissa — thanks for the flag and for attaching the docs. Short answers below: 

- Net-45 is not ideal but acceptable for pilots under $500k if procurement signs an explicit billing cadence. We will need an explicit PO date to lock recognition.
- We can issue a prorated invoice if the PO includes the exact service start date. Billing system supports backdating invoices by up to 7 days with approval; beyond that requires finance sign-off.
- From a rev rec perspective, we need either (A) a PO with an explicit start date in March, or (B) a signed SOW with a 3/1 effective date. Otherwise booking recognition moves to April.

Attached is a cleaned PO template with suggested field entries for start date and payment terms: Starlight_PO_Template.pdf. Marissa — if you can send this to their procurement and request 3/1 as the effective start, we should be able to keep the booking in Q1 conditional on receiving the signed PO by 3/5.

David Kim
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
+david_kim@redwood.ai
